_comment: W2-SEAS-F 2026-11-08. Briefcase item rows for snow play and raking (catalogue registration in item_catalog.gd / shop_items.gd is W3-INTEGRATION's), and which held items dress a snowman (world/seasons/snow_play/snow_play.gd part_for). A key ending in * matches every id with that prefix.

coal.name: Lump of coal
coal.description: Hold it to a snowman's face for an eye, or to its middle for a button.

stick.name: Stick
stick.description: A bare twig. Hold it to a snowman's side for an arm.

rake.name: Leaf rake
rake.description: Drag it through scattered leaves to rake them back into a pile. Desktop: hold click and sweep.
